name: trend_ens
description: Multi-speed trend ensemble (9 lookbacks 5-360d, Donchian state machine or TSMOM sign) on the 16 long-lived 'majors' Binance USDT-M perps, 6h bars, per-asset inverse-vol sizing with the full-conviction book scaled to 20% ex-ante vol, relative rebalance band, optional funding-crowding gate on new exposure.
mechanism: Time-series momentum: slow information diffusion plus attention/leverage-driven retail flow make crypto trends persist; averaging 9 speeds diversifies parameter risk; the channel-midpoint trailing exit keeps the right tail open. Counterparties: mean-reversion/range traders, late entrants, forced sellers. Funding gate: high perp funding = crowded leveraged longs that precede crashes (BIS WP 1087), so new longs are cut when the 7d mean funding is in the top decile of its trailing year or > 30% annualised.
universe: majors (16 long-lived coins; tradable = valid bar)

btceth_6h.window: 2022-01-01..2025-06-30 (each fixed config, NO selection; not a tradable OOS number)

majors_6h.window: 2022-01-01..2025-06-30 (each fixed config, NO selection; not a tradable OOS number)

pit10_6h.window: 2022-01-01..2025-06-30 (each fixed config, NO selection; not a tradable OOS number)

frozen_rule: best median train Sharpe across the 7 walk-forward folds
trades_note: trades_per_day = position round trips opened per day (OOS); fills_per_day = all position changes incl. resizes
caveats: Verdict 'marginal' rather than 'fails': the pre-registered walk-forward misses the 0.8 bar (0.33), but the timing edge is real. FROZEN weights beat 200 random-timing permutations (p=0.005) and 100 sign-flip permutations (p=0.01), and the median fixed config over 2022-2025H1 has Sharpe ~0.67. The edge is small (~0.3-0.9 Sharpe at 10-12% vol): a diversifier, not a return engine.

Universe/timeframe exploration (54-config walk-forward each, same folds): BTC+ETH 6h 0.19, BTC+ETH 1d 0.04, majors 6h 0.33, majors 1d 0.48, pit-top10 6h 0.60, pit-top10 1d 0.35. None reaches 0.8; the old v8 audit figure of ~0.56 is in the same range. BTC+ETH alone is the weakest.

Walk-forward OOS (2022-01..2025-06, 7 rolling folds, 730d train / 182d test, 54-config grid picked by train Sharpe): Sharpe 0.33, CAGR 3.0%, maxDD -20.6%, realised vol 10.6%. Phase-1 pass bar (OOS Sharpe >= 0.8) is NOT met.

Grid selection by train Sharpe did not persist. On BTC+ETH 6h (checked fold by fold) the train winner landed at the 6th-50th percentile of the 54 configs in every following test half-year; fold 0 picks long-only after the 2020-21 bull and loses in 2022H1. On majors 6h the walk-forward (0.33) is below the median FIXED config over 2022-2025H1 (0.67, see grid_summary.grid_2022_window). That median is hindsight over the grid, not an achievable OOS number.
Deflated Sharpe 0.045 with n_trials=54; with all 324 explored trials (6 universe x timeframe walk-forwards of 54) 0.010.
Random-timing null (same holding lengths/values, runs permuted per symbol) on FROZEN weights 2021-01..2025-06: percentile 100, p=0.005.

Realised vol is ~10-12%, not 20%: vol_target sizes the FULL-CONVICTION book (|signal|=1 on every active coin) to 20% ex-ante; partial ensemble signals keep exposure lower (mean gross ~0.2x). Returns scale ~linearly with vol_target (see vol_target_scaling_dev); drawdowns scale with it too.

Rebalance band is RELATIVE (trade when |target-held| > band x max(|target|,|held|)), not the spec's absolute 5-20% of equity: at 20% book vol a single coin's weight is ~1-8% of equity, so an absolute band would block nearly every entry.

Donchian entries/exits are evaluated only at 6h closes and filled at the next open (routine cadence). Resting server-side stop-market entries / conditional exits at the channel levels were not modelled.
2025H1 is negative in every universe/timeframe tried (chop + V-reversal regime); 2024 carries most of the OOS return.

Funding gate: walk-forward on gate-off configs only -> OOS Sharpe 0.81; gate-on configs only -> 0.37. Fixed-config effect (FROZEN with gate 1/0.5/0, 2022-2025H1 window): Sharpe 0.88/0.89/0.91, maxDD -12.3%/-12.0%/-12.6%. The gate mostly trims exposure; it does not change the verdict.
Signal warm-up: lookbacks without N days of history count as 0, so the 2020 part of the first training window (and newly listed coins) run on a damped signal.
Costs: Bybit taker 0.055%/side + tiered slippage (1/3/8 bp) + Binance funding history as a proxy for Bybit funding.

Gate-off-only walk-forward (18 configs, a spec-requested variant): OOS Sharpe 0.81, CAGR 9.8%, maxDD -16.1% (2022 +10.7%, 2023 +1.1%, 2024 +25.5%, 2025H1 -1.5%); DSR (54 trials, headline skew/kurt) 0.212. The gap to the headline sits almost entirely in fold 0 (2022H1), i.e. in which config the 2020-21 training window happened to pick. Treat it as selection luck, not as evidence that the gate hurts.
$200 account with Bybit qty rounding at vol_target 0.20: dropped-order share 87%, Sharpe 1.01 vs 1.12 fractional (dev period). Many resizes are below the $5 minimum notional at this size.
lockbox: not touched (all panels end 2025-06-30, pre_lockbox applied)
